title: Reach the date with a keyboard
goal: A customer who uses only the keyboard books the 09:00 slot on a chosen date, and the booking is saved and reopens with that exact date.

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The date picker does not accept manual keyboard input because the flatpickr configuration lacks the allowInput option, causing the entered date to be ignored and the date step to stall.

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The date field is a div that is not focusable via Tab, preventing keyboard users from entering a date manually. Additionally, flatpickr lacks the allowInput option, blocking manual date entry even if focused.

edits.new: <input type="text" id="select-date" class="form-control mx-auto my-4" autocomplete="off">

steps.headline: Confirmation shown, but saved for 2026-11-01 09:00 instead of 2026-11-02 09:00

evidence.error: Outcome verification failed: wrong_start_datetime, wrong_end_datetime_or_duration, reopen_date_mismatch

timeline_after_typing_date.event: no key pressed (page changed it) → date field shows "01/11/2026"

steps.diagnosis: The date picker shifts the selected date by one day due to timezone mismatch between the browser (UTC) and the business timezone (Asia/Riyadh). Adding the utc:true option to flatpickr ensures dates are interpreted without conversion, keeping the entered date stable.

edits.new: <input type="text" id="select-date" class="form-control mx-auto my-4" autocomplete="off">

steps.headline: Confirmation shown, but saved for 2026-11-01 09:00 instead of 2026-11-02 09:00

evidence.error: Outcome verification failed: wrong_start_datetime, wrong_end_datetime_or_duration, reopen_date_mismatch

timeline_after_typing_date.event: no key pressed (page changed it) → date field shows "01/11/2026"

steps.diagnosis: The date picker shifts the selected date by one day because flatpickr interprets the entered date in the browser's UTC timezone without the utc:true option, causing the stored date to be off when combined with the selected time. Adding utc:true ensures the date remains unchanged.

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The date picker's internal date value shifts by one day due to timezone conversion when constructing the start datetime. Using the input's raw value (which reflects the user's entered date) avoids this shift while preserving calendar functionality.

edits.new: <input type="text" id="select-date" class="form-control mx-auto my-4" autocomplete="off">

steps.headline: Keyboard user got stuck at the date step: there is no date field to Tab to

steps.diagnosis: The date picker's inline mode combined with manual input causes the date to be reset after AJAX calls, likely due to the calendar trying to synchronize with an internal date that shifts by one day because of timezone handling. Removing the inline flag makes the date picker behave as a standard input, preventing unwanted date changes while still allowing keyboard entry and calendar dropdown.

evidence.error: Outcome verification failed: wrong_start_datetime, wrong_end_datetime_or_duration, reopen_date_mismatch

timeline_after_typing_date.event: no key pressed (page changed it) → date field shows "01/11/2026"

steps.diagnosis: The date picker interprets the entered date in the business timezone (Asia/Riyadh) instead of the browser timezone (UTC), causing the stored date to be one day earlier. Setting flatpickr's timezone option to 'UTC' ensures parsing and display use UTC, preventing the shift.

steps.diagnosis: The date picker's inline mode combined with manual input causes the date to be reset after AJAX calls due to internal synchronization issues.
